Metformin inhibits hepatic glucose production and increases muscle glucose uptake. The effects of empagliflozin on diuresis and natriuresis in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and liver cirrhosis. We investigated the short-term diuretic and natriuretic effect of empagliflozin, a sodium-glucose linked transporter 2 inhibitor, in patients with cirrhosis and type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).
